Successive distribution CDF differences factor D J_z=C_z D: each C column has positive support on exactly w consecutive cyclic output edges and sum 1. Therefore global two-input cyclic variation ≤ input variation. If w<n<2w every positive and negative gradient column pair intersects and strict triangle inequality applies at every finite segment point. If n≥2w, two disjoint complete windows give finite equality. If w<n<2w, a one-site dominating input pair approaches gain 1 without attaining it. If w=n the output is constant. w=1 and n=2 covered.
